title: Replace g_snprintf() with snprintf()
description: Use macros from inttypes.h with format strings.

commits_data.title: Replace g_snprintf() with snprintf()
commits_data.message:
Replace g_snprintf() with snprintf()

Use macros from inttypes.h with format strings.
